title: Jesus... I Don't Open The Door Anymore. 🔒
topic: he chained his door after a year of being let down and now even good company gets turned away at the threshold

bible.text: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I don't open the door anymore. 🔒

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: The chain stays on. Even friends get turned away.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I don't force doors. I stand and knock.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Even for You? I'm out of practice at this.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Lift the chain a crack. I'll sit at your table tonight.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Open slowly if you must. But don't leave Me outside.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone who stopped opening their door. 🔒
